messages:
Priya: Quick follow-up from the authz postmortem. Need owners for: token validation rotation, permissions cleanup, audit-log gap, and a recurring detection plan. Keep replies short so I can paste into the follow-up doc.
Amir: I will own token rotation. Plan: rotate critical machine tokens first (ci-runner, deployer, scheduler). Critical rotate in 48h, full sweep in 7d. Will add runbook checks.
Lena: I can take perms cleanup. I'll snapshot IAM + k8s bindings, produce a diff vs baseline, and open remediation PRs. ETA 5 business days.
Gus: I'll investigate missing audit events. Hypothesis: forwarder filter + indexing lag. I'll enable 24h verbose sampling and replay traces. ETA 24-36h for root cause + mitigation.
Marta (infra): Verbose logging guard: I'll add autoscale rule for log shippers and a 12h alert on disk > 75%. Also temporary throttle to S3 if egress spikes.
sec-bot: Created ticket SEC-1001: "authz follow-up: token+perms+audit" assigned to Priya. Link: https://redwood.internal/sec/SEC-1001
Amir: Rotation validation snippet (to post in SEC-1001): `curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $NEW\" https://auth.redwood.internal/introspect | jq .active` expect true; old token -> 401/false.
Lena: Perms audit commands I'll use: `gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --format=json` and `kubectl get rolebindings --all-namespaces -o json`. Will post CSV mapping principals->services.
Gus: Forwarder override (temp): `filters:\n  include:\n    - event: token.introspect\n    - event: token.issue\n    - level: info` I'll paste samples into SEC-1001.
Priya: Action summary: Amir -> rotate critical tokens (48h) + sweep (7d); Lena -> perms diff + PRs (5d); Gus -> audit-root-cause + mitigation (36h); Marta -> infra guards (now). Review meeting in 3 business days. Please put PR links & runbook snippets into SEC-1001. This thread is canonical for owners/timelines.
